Read README.md, project.godot, scenes/main.tscn, scenes/movement.gd and scenes/collectible_actions.gd; current main declares Godot 4.5 and includes maze meshes, collectible scenes, music and text-overlay resources. Held as candidate by supervisor decision because the current catalog has no approved prominent warning/opt-in policy for this game's intentional metafictional local side effects. In https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rayhimmel/blank/main/scenes/collectible_actions.gd, create_file uses OS.get_system_dir(OS.SYSTEM_DIR_DESKTOP) and FileAccess.open(file_path, FileAccess.WRITE), and collectible actions call create_file with 31122024.txt and 05102025.txt. If a same-name desktop file already exists, it calls OS.shell_open(file_path); otherwise it writes the game's narrative text. Actions also call game_window.minimize(). corrupt_game writes OS.get_user_data_dir() + "/corrupted.flag" and quits; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rayhimmel/blank/main/scenes/movement.gd checks that flag on later starts, displays a fictional fatal error and disables physics/input processing, blocking normal play. These are observed author-designed metafiction behaviors, not a malware determination. Nothing was executed, and no complete security audit or safety claim was made. Future inclusion requires an explicit user decision on this category and its prominent warnings.
